high_level_description: The image depicts a modern, curved walkway with a sleek, contemporary design. The walkway is enclosed on both sides by large, translucent panels that allow natural light to filter through, creating a bright and airy atmosphere. The ceiling features a series of horizontal metal beams that add to the structural aesthetic. Several people are walking along the walkway. In the foreground, two individuals are walking away from the camera, while another person is walking towards the camera.
